previous_release.note: The registry has no 0.0.56. The immediately preceding published release reproduces the same suspicious cache finding with the original rules.

decisive_diff.other_changes: Object relationships, SQL helpers, enumeration helpers, debug output, reduced stress tests, and an equivalent detached-command expression. No new install hook, stage, or obfuscated loader.

reverse_engineering: The gem declares a general Ruby HTTP/SSH/utility framework and no gem installation extensions or executables. Knj.const_missing lazily loads utility classes.

The JRuby SQLite driver requires the bundled JDBC JAR, then opens a caller-specified jdbc:sqlite database. NativeDB.load selects the platform resource, writes it to a temporary file, registers deleteOnExit, and loads that file. This is normal JNI deployment.

SQLite 3.6.14.2 mac-universal.lib contains PPC, x86, and x86-64 slices. In x86-64 function 0x3025a, instructions 0x302cf onward copy the conch host-ID path, open with create/exclusive flags and mode 0644, read an existing 128-byte ID or generate random bytes and pwrite a new ID, then compare it during proxy-lock coordination. This matches upstream os_unix.c.

org/ibex/nestedvm/Runtime.class declares setSecurityManager(Runtime$SecurityManager), which only assigns its own sm field. It does not import java/lang/System.setSecurityManager. The old bare-name matcher falsely asserted a JVM override call.

Iotop constructs iotop -bPk with integer PID filters, reads process I/O statistics via IO.popen, and exposes the parsed data. The speed test writes and reads the explicitly supplied temporary filename in timed loops, reports throughput, and removes that file.

Http2 implements caller-configured TCP/SSL/proxy requests, cookies, forms, multipart uploads, and temporary-file cleanup. Those capabilities and the package process/permission/encoding traits are retained. There is no observed hostile source-to-sink chain.

rule_changes.change: Preserve detection and ID; change suspicious to notable, explicitly describe a path reference, remove unsupported T1564.001 mapping, and retain complete dotted names and child paths. No filename exception or file-wide suppression.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: A hidden-entry reference alone does not establish concealment; the actual match is a standard SQLite lock-coordination file.

rule_changes.change: Replace an unqualified text name with the qualified java/lang/System.setSecurityManager import, retain notable severity, and update the sole exact consumer.
rule_changes.unsupported_claim: A declaration of an unrelated VM setter does not prove calling or overriding the host JVM manager.

rule_changes.change: Add a Ruby command-literal reference matcher; exclude comment-only mentions, filename strings and longer identifier substrings by construction. Existing raw iotop scopes are retained and their description clarified.

consumer_audit.external_sample_review: Searched the 39 files (approximately 298 MB) in the supplied samples directory for raw hidden-Library-cache paths; no relevant uncompressed positive outside this gem was present. Inspected existing testdata/triage/platformdirs-and-xyo/triage-positive.py. Retained hostile consumer behavior is tested with inert native controls and compile-only Java controls; these are synthetic, not recovered malware.

context_limit: No installation or deployment context was supplied. The verdict applies to the inspected package contents and authenticated registry release comparison.
coverage_result: No supported attack detection was removed. The hidden-cache reference remains under the same ID at notable severity. The sole removed notable finding was an unsupported JVM override claim on an unrelated setter declaration. Inert SILENCELIFT consumer and compile-only JVM policy-bypass controls still fire hostile. Networking, permission changes, execution, encoding and cryptographic observations were retained.
classifier_disagreement: None after correction: the outer gem and archive members are classifier BENIGN before and after. Atomscan warned that its v18 model lacks newer v21 feature inputs; this is a model limitation, not evidence about sample intent.
